title: Top app menu, user menu and mega menus
summary: Replaces the left glass sidebar with a top app menu: one mega menu per module, a simple signed-out menu, and a separate user menu.
changes: Desktop chrome is a sticky top app bar; the left frosted rail is no longer the primary navigation.
Each enabled module opens a mega menu of plugin actions; staff also get Clients and Admin menus.
Guests see a simple top link list (Open a ticket, Recruitment, Bookings, Help, Login, Register).
Personal links (profile, theme, help, sign out, QA pill) live in a separate avatar user menu.
Small screens use a hamburger drawer with accordion module menus and focus trapping.
Ctrl K search and the notification bell sit in the top bar; palette labels name their module.
Menu items are filtered by ability and plugin enablement; empty modules and staff Bookings stay hidden.
version_rationale: MINOR: new top navigation and mega menus replace the sidebar layout across the app.
validation: Feature and unit navigation tests (signed-out, public, staff, admin, filtering, palette labels, shell).
Frontend Vitest for guided tour and workspace scripts.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for the top bar without the left rail.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.74.0 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Legacy rail and user-dock Blade components remain in the tree but are not used as primary chrome.
Full Theme section (Glassy/Jungle) lands in a later milestone; this release keeps the light/dark toggle slot.
Admin Security regrouping stays in v0.80.0.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.73.0). No database migrations ship with this release.
provenance: Milestone v0.74.0 Top app menu, user menu and mega menus, Epic #862, pull request #1018.
